deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Operate proposal review, feedback coordination, transparent fund distribution, and KPI/result tracking for funded work.
Continue KPI dashboard development toward live on-chain Cardano data tracking and recurring KPI reporting standards with dReps.
Disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds initially received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism for Cardano builders aligned with Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is proposed as an ecosystem-wide, smart contract-governed funding mechanism for projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.
The proposal says funded projects will be required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
The DAO claims it has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
The proposal claims Round 1 funded 20 companies, distributed 5,541,335 ADA, included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, and achieved 83% governance participation.
The proposal claims Round 2 funded 14 companies, added 18 new members, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.
The proposal says the DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 KPI dashboards, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward live on-chain Cardano data.

The proposal states official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

The administrator is described as an independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional unaffiliated active dRep, using separate auditable accounts, no stake-pool delegation, predefined abstain voting delegation, and independent multisig milestone disbursement.
The proposal says unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds would be returned to the Cardano Treasury, and cites a transaction for a prior 354,790 ADA return after the first two rounds.

The proposal states Clarity will not seek funding as a requesting member through initiative DAOs and that the tools and technology needed to enable these DAOs were funded by the Cardano Builder DAO in 2025.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale builder-led treasury allocation tied to MAU, transaction, and TVL KPIs, citing prior funding rounds, KPI dashboard work, governance participation, independent administration, milestone-based disbursement, and a prior return of unused funds.
